Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished hand-painted dark-fantasy LIGHTNING VFX animation sprites, transparent RGBA PNG atlas for an original 2D side-view action game.
Produce EXACTLY 24 distinct consecutive animation phases in EXACTLY 4 columns x 6 rows on a 1024x1536 portrait canvas. Each cell is 256x256, reading left-to-right then next row. F phases 0-7 = first TWO rows; E phases0-7=middle TWO; R phases0-7=bottom TWO. No frame labels, grid, borders or background. True transparency: empty pixels and gutters must be alpha exactly ZERO, not translucent gray mist, not a checkerboard, not a gray/black rectangle. Transparent empty gutters 18px inside EVERY tile. Glow belongs only close to visible lightning and tapers completely to alpha0. No atmospheric wash spanning tiles.
Style: lavish original hand-painted dark fantasy, clearly legible warm GOLD-WHITE branching lightning, white-hot cores, thin molten gold edges, small cool blue-violet secondary sparks; ornate antique-gold physical chain links and lightning-forged faceted armor material. Crisp energetic brush detail, controlled bloom, powerful but readable. Materials match the project's engraved gold lightning icons and previous punch/chain/ground lightning VFX. Do not use plain vector diagrams or fuzzy clouds.
Animation continuity: actual deformation, rotation, extension, impact and dissolution between phases, never eight copies merely changing brightness. Same camera and common scale, fully contained x18..238,y18..238. Stable cell center (128,128) for F and E; R same horizontal center and ground contact y210. All horizontal attacks face RIGHT along x-axis, tails LEFT.
F Remote Thunder Fist, eight phases first two rows. ONE projectile of giant closed FIST made entirely from branching GOLD-WHITE thunder, no skin, no person or arm. Phases: 0 small compressed gold-white thunder knot with knuckle facets beginning; 1 closed magical fist clearly gathers, thin branches coil backward; 2 firm oversized lightning fist fires RIGHT, recognisable four knuckles and folded thumb of lightning, short left tail; 3 same fist thrusts faster RIGHT, forward knuckles compress and tail branches bend backward coherently; 4 knuckles strike, fist flattens and branching impact crown flares toward RIGHT around same center; 5 fist breaks into an expanding gold-white branching ring and short zigzag shards; 6 branching ring splits into fading forks and gold flecks; 7 only a few small curved forked sparks. The first 4 phases should read as one coherent punch projectile, no detached human limb and no continuous laser.
E Thunder Chain Recoil/Pierce, eight phases middle two rows. 0 three gold links with tiny electric knot begin coiling around center; 1 circular chain coil forms with three lightning nodes; 2 chain rotates clockwise into an elliptical sweep, link perspective changes; 3 chain whips open to the RIGHT in a curved diagonal lashing extension while its left end remains coiled; 4 three-node chain lashes through center toward RIGHT as a clear elongated S-curve with coherent gold links and branching arcs; 5 chain snaps back into tightened revolving coil, changing link orientation and node positions; 6 chain fractures into a short fan of gold links and small white forks; 7 a few separate links and dying sparks. Stable overall center and no opaque shadow background.
R Thunder God War Body, eight phases bottom two rows. This is GROUND-CENTRED magical armor apparition and thunder domain with NO HUMAN BODY, no human face, no actual character, no skin, no head or limbs. An abstract ornate phantom chestplate/shoulder crest of gold-white lightning floats above an elliptical thunder seal. Phase0 thin low elliptical gold seal with small crawling branches; 1 gold lightning veins gather on same floor ellipse, a small floating armor crest forms above center; 2 the faceted chestplate/winged shoulder crest builds from floating gold fragments, squat vertical forks rise; 3 full ornate phantom battle cuirass crest with gold-white wing-shaped arcs and intense center over floor seal; 4 crest opens its winged arcs outward, branching thunder roots run along floor, empty central transparent space reserved for the game character; 5 crest contracts as jagged forks rotate around its same floor center; 6 armor crest separates into floating gold plates while floor branches retract; 7 sparse gold pieces and very thin floor ellipse. Ground ellipse fully contained and same contact center (128,210) every phase. No tall laser pillar or humanoid silhouette.
Avoid: characters, bodies, faces, skin, hands with flesh, person holding effects, landscape, platforms, UI frames, title, text, letters, numbers, watermark, panel lines, opaque backgrounds, gray translucent background haze, shared aura between frames, clipped effect edges. All 24 phases must be distinct, richly detailed, independently usable, with real empty transparent gutters.
